messages.text: Afternoon all. Prepping the review packs for Thursday. I have {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0068}} at 10am and {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0239}} at 2pm. Tricia, are you pulling the performance attribution out of PortfolioMgr for both?
Yep, I'll run attribution for both this afternoon. For {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0068}} it's a quiet story, low risk, tracking the benchmark closely. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0239}} is the one with more to talk about.
Right, high risk profile and the concentration in tech has grown since the last review. Michael is the RM on that one, should he join the prep?
Jumping in. For any high risk client review I want the suitability refresh done before the meeting, not during it. Has the risk questionnaire on c_0239 been updated in ClientHub recently?
Checking ClientHub now. Last questionnaire was filed in the spring, so it's within 12 months but I'd flag it for a refresh anyway given the allocation drift.
Agreed. Please add a note on the contact record and have Michael confirm with the client whether anything changed in their situation or objectives.
Quick question on the cash side: should I include the cash_management account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00489}} in the {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0239}} deck, or keep it to brokerage {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00488}} only?
Include both. Clients like seeing the full liquidity picture, and it matters for the conversation about how much dry powder they want to hold.
I'll add a liquidity slide then. Cash balance trend plus any pending transfers over the last quarter.

Rebalance preview for {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00488}} is ready in PortfolioMgr. Trimming the overweight tech sleeve would take it back inside the policy band, but there's a tax lot consideration I want to run past the group.
Don't execute anything before the meeting. Present it as a proposal with the estimated realized gains, and let the client decide. Put the lot-level detail in an appendix.
Makes sense, proposal only. I'll have the appendix drafted by end of day tomorrow.
For {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0068}} I'm confirming the meeting by email to {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0068}} and will also try {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0068}} if I don't hear back by tomorrow noon.
Good. Also ask whether they want to discuss anything beyond the standard agenda. Long-standing client since 2021, so I'd like us to ask about any upcoming life changes.
Will do. I'll add a line in the confirmation email and update ClientHub with the response either way.
Attribution for {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00144}} and {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00145}} is done and uploaded to the shared folder. Low risk portfolio is within a few bps of benchmark, nothing unusual.
Thanks Tricia, pulling it into the deck now. I'll send a draft of both packs to you and Grace tomorrow morning.
Perfect. Let's do a 20 minute dry run Wednesday at 3pm with Michael on the line for the {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0239}} one. I'll send the invite.
